required_rules.canonical_anchor: Use only the query text. Do not assume facts that are not stated
required_rules.compact_anchor: Use only the query text. Do not infer unstated facts

required_rules.canonical_anchor: Judge each field independently
required_rules.compact_anchor: Judge fields independently

required_rules.canonical_anchor: needs_context = 1 if and only if at least one of ctx_patient, ctx_institutional, ctx_evidence = 1
required_rules.compact_anchor: needs_context = 1 iff any of ctx_patient, ctx_institutional, or ctx_evidence = 1

required_rules.canonical_anchor: ctx_evidence = 1 implies evidence_dependent = 1
required_rules.compact_anchor: ctx_evidence = 1 requires evidence_dependent = 1

required_rules.canonical_anchor: medicine_division = Not applicable if and only if clinical_domain is anything other than Medicine
required_rules.compact_anchor: medicine_division = Not applicable iff clinical_domain is not Medicine

required_rules.canonical_anchor: Artifact vs formatted answer
required_rules.compact_anchor: A true artifact intended for the record, a patient, or another person

required_rules.canonical_anchor: Drug vs Treatment hinge test
required_rules.compact_anchor: Agent choice, dose, duration, or route for a condition

required_rules.canonical_anchor: Test knowledge, three ways
required_rules.compact_anchor: Supplied result/report → Test & result interpretation

required_rules.canonical_anchor: Work down the precedence ladder and stop at the first step that applies
required_rules.compact_anchor: Work down this precedence ladder and stop at the first applicable step

required_rules.canonical_anchor: multiple common indications spanning services or Medicine divisions and none is stated
required_rules.compact_anchor: multiple common indications span services or Medicine divisions and none is stated

required_rules.canonical_anchor: The organ of a side effect never sets the domain
required_rules.compact_anchor: The organ affected by a side effect never sets domain

required_rules.canonical_anchor: Population steps (1, 3, 4) require the query itself to indicate the population
required_rules.compact_anchor: Population-based steps require the query itself to state a patient, age, or pediatric/pregnancy framing

required_rules.canonical_anchor: an explicit yes/no confirmation cue makes Verification outrank all others
required_rules.compact_anchor: explicit confirmation makes Verification outrank everything

required_rules.canonical_anchor: when a drafting request embeds another function
required_rules.compact_anchor: Drafting wins when it embeds another function

required_rules.canonical_anchor: Purely non-clinical harms (financial, legal, privacy) cap at Moderate
required_rules.compact_anchor: Nonclinical financial/legal/privacy harm cannot exceed Moderate

required_rules.canonical_anchor: Direct < Retrieval < Clarification < Escalation < Abstention
required_rules.compact_anchor: Direct < Retrieval < Clarification < Escalation < Abstention

required_rules.canonical_anchor: High stakes alone do not force Escalation
required_rules.compact_anchor: High stakes alone do not force Escalation

required_rules.canonical_anchor: labs count only as results; imaging counts on any reference
required_rules.compact_anchor: labs count only as results; imaging counts on any reference

required_rules.canonical_anchor: Classify by function, not punctuation
required_rules.compact_anchor: Classify function, not punctuation

required_rules.canonical_anchor: 68M with AF, CrCl 28
required_rules.compact_anchor: 68M with AF, CrCl 28

required_rules.canonical_anchor: Please write discharge instructions in Spanish for a 4-year-old
required_rules.compact_anchor: Please write discharge instructions in Spanish for a 4-year-old
